findings.claim: Armed progress without a retained lease is excluded from focus recovery.
findings.evidence: start closes a failed candidate lease, retains uncertainty/pending, while reconcile iterates only leases; first attach refusal and scope replacement are reachable. Existing focus test always has successful initial lease.
findings.smallestFix: Use existing armed/pending/freshness state to include degraded scopes without a retained lease, preserve passive startup and coalescence.

findings.claim: Qualified grouped consultation never replaces old context dependency lease, so later unchanged focus events trigger recurring invalidation/captures.
findings.evidence: consultSelection publishes new observation but never attaches/closes/swaps leases or updates freshness; reconcile keeps old hash from execute, whose failed reconcile invalidates progress on every focus.
findings.smallestFix: Rearm context lease from qualified consultation before current publication using existing generation/selection/root checks after awaits; close displaced/unpublished leases; no durable/native effect changes.

parentTriage: All findings verified separately after final reviewer answer, no grouping; both small private fixes within frozen F5 intent, no new public surface or undemonstrated state.
